items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: I had a band there playing with Chris Kelly. We had a good, uh, rough outfit.

ctx.x: You know him? Yes. Maybe Matthews was playing drum. I think that's the band there. And, uh, after I went playing, gigging, you know, from one place to another, I had a band there playing with Chris Kelly. We had a good, uh, rough outfit. Oh, yeah.
Right. Yes. Heard they played a lot of blues. Is that right? A lot of blues. Yes, that's right.
